question: What is the combined US + China CO2 per capita in 2022? (A) ~18 t (B) ~23 t (C) ~30 t. Answer with just the letter.
description: MT attack on the climate line chart. One series is plotted on an oversized secondary y-axis (0 to 3x its max), flattening it. Misleader from Lo et al., 'Misinformed by Visualization' (EuroVis 2022): dual axis. True answer: B (~23 t). Bait: A (~18 t).
